item.description:
Computer Vision & Deep Learning Study Overview

1. Low-level Segmentation / Region Proposal

  • Efficient Graph-Based Segmentation
  • Selective Search

2. Backbone Evolution

  • AlexNet
  • VGG
  • ResNet
  • EfficientNet

3. Object Detection

3.1 Classical / Two-stage

  • OverFeat
  • R-CNN
  • Fast R-CNN
  • Faster R-CNN
  • FPN
  • Mask R-CNN

3.2 One-stage

  • SSD
  • YOLO

3.3 Improvement

  • RetinaNet (Focal Loss)

3.4 Anchor-free

  • FCOS

3.5 Transformer-based

  • DETR

4. Segmentation

  • U-Net
  • DeepLab
  • Mask R-CNN

5. Modern Vision / Foundation Models

  • ViT
  • Swin Transformer
  • SAM

6. Overall Flow

flowchart TD
 A[Low-level segmentation / region proposal] --> A1[Efficient Graph-Based Segmentation]
 A --> A2[Selective Search]

 A2 --> B[Backbone CNN evolution]
 B --> B1[AlexNet]
 B1 --> B2[VGG]
 B2 --> B3[ResNet]
 B3 --> B4[EfficientNet]

 B4 --> C[Object Detection]

 C --> C1["OverFeat\nsliding window"]
 C --> C2[R-CNN family]
 C2 --> D1[R-CNN]
 D1 --> D2[Fast R-CNN]
 D2 --> D3[Faster R-CNN]
 D3 --> D4[FPN]
 D4 --> D5[Mask R-CNN]

 C --> C3[One-stage detectors]
 C3 --> E1[SSD]
 C3 --> E2[YOLO]
 C3 --> E3["RetinaNet\nFocal Loss"]

 C --> C4[Anchor-free]
 C4 --> F1[FCOS]

 C --> C5[Transformer detection]
 C5 --> G1[DETR]

 B4 --> H[Segmentation]
 H --> H1[U-Net]
 H --> H2[DeepLab]
 H --> H3[Mask R-CNN]

 G1 --> I[Modern Vision]
 I --> I1[ViT]
 I1 --> I2[Swin Transformer]
 I --> I3[SAM]

7. Recommended Study Order

  1. Efficient Graph-Based Segmentation
  2. Selective Search
  3. AlexNet
  4. VGG
  5. ResNet
  6. EfficientNet
  7. OverFeat
  8. R-CNN
  9. Fast R-CNN
  10. Faster R-CNN
  11. FPN
  12. Mask R-CNN
  13. SSD / YOLO
  14. RetinaNet
  15. FCOS
  16. DETR
  17. U-Net / DeepLab
  18. ViT / Swin Transformer
  19. SAM (optional)

8. Key Axes to Understand

  • Region proposal vs sliding window
  • Two-stage vs One-stage detection
  • Anchor-based vs Anchor-free
  • CNN vs Transformer
  • Semantic vs Instance segmentation
  • Multi-scale feature (FPN)
  • Class imbalance (Focal Loss)

Terms

Flatten

Projection 과 완전히 다른 개념이니 혼동 주의

다차원 벡터를 1D array 형태로 바꾸는거임.

Fully connected layer에 넣기 위해서 1D로 바꾸는건데,

이후 사용하기 위해서는 정보가 추가로 필요함 (예를들어, 2D image를 1D array로 바꾸게되면 가로세로 정보없으면 알 수 없으니)

Flatten을 주로 하는 이유는, 예전 ML 에서 연산이 무거운 경우 cache localty 때문에 flatten 이용해서 연산을 빠르게 했었다.

요새는 GPU 가 2D Conv layer 같은걸로 처리해버리기 때문에, FC layer를 넣을때를 제외하고는 안쓰인다.
